plan.notes: Source: official University of Northern Colorado 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, 'Nursing B.S.N.' (College of Natural and Health Sciences). The catalog publishes the 105-credit required major as a course list with no official term-by-term sequence — collected as a single requirements block. The program is a nine-semester structure (4 pre-clinical + 5 clinical semesters); BIO 110, BIO 245, BIO 246, BIO 251, CHEM 281, CHEM 281L, ENG 123, FND 250, NURS 326, PSY 230, and STAT 150 are prerequisite courses required prior to admission to the clinical phase (separate competitive admission). Degree total 120: Required Major 105 + Liberal Arts Curriculum 31 (the catalog recommends LAC courses that double-count toward the 105 major credits) + University Wide Credits 0. 'NURS 374 Clinical Practice: Alterations in Adult Health' corrects an obvious 'Heath' typo in the catalog. A minimum grade of C (C- not acceptable) is required in nursing courses for progression.
